_comment: Run template for lbnl-boiler: the hot-water loop differential-pressure reset. The boiler status points are enables, not firing (see the catalog's data issues), so rules needing boiler_status decline here. This rule detects none of the 16 faults. Boiler fouling shows as gas input per unit of heat (boiler 1's gas +57% at 065): since 0.92 the gas input maps to gas_input_rate and the boiler drift family (boiler_efficiency_drift) reads it. There is still no supply-temperature setpoint to compare the loop supply with. 0.98 (#86): the boiler drift family scores every run against the declared reference PLANT__fault_free (drift.families[].reference), re-read on every run and never stored: boiler_efficiency_drift reads boiler 1's gas input per unit of heat delivered. Measured on the full subset: boiler fouling 065 / 080 / 095 +54 / +25 / +5.1 % (fault / fault / warn; 095 clears the 5 % warn floor by 0.1 point); 0 of the 13 other runs fire, and the +2 / +4 F hot-water temperature-bias runs are reported as heat-metering problems (info). The fault-free run is the reference, so it declines (is_reference); camber datasets score still counts it as a correct negative, so the false-positive count reads 0 of 14.
